item.title: IPAK Group sustains strong momentum with consolidated net profit rising to PKR 1.47 billion
item.description: IPAK Group has delivered another strong performance for the half year ended 31 December 2025, resulting in a consolidated net profit to PKR 1.47 billion compared to PKR 377 million in the corresponding period last year, translating into an earnings per share (EPS) of PKR 2.19, highlighting the Group’s strengthening operational leverage and financial resilience.
